Here, we apply the product rule and the power rule to get

$$
\eqalign{
\lim_\limits{x\rightarrow 3}\left[(2x-1)^3(x-2)^9\right]   &= \lim_\limits{x\rightarrow 3}(2x-1)^3\cdot  \lim_\limits{x\rightarrow 3}(x-2)^9\[3pt]
                                                                                    &= \left(\lim_\limits{x\rightarrow 3}(2x-1)\right)^3\cdot  \left(\lim_\limits{x\rightarrow 3}(x-2)\right)^9\[3pt]
                                                                                    &= (2\cdot 3 -1)^3\cdot (3-2)^9\[3pt]
                                                                                    &= 5^3 \cdot 1^9\[3pt]
                                                                                    & = 125.
}
$$
